fields.description: How many days an activation/delegation request may wait before it lapses. Owner policy; engineering invents none.
fields.label: Delegation window days

fields.description: Whether a pre-admission proxy (guardian acting before enrollment) is allowed. The owner chooses Allowed or Refused; no default is offered.
fields.label: Pre-admission proxy

fields.description: How consent must be evidenced: Link (a linked authorization record), Attachment (an attached evidence file), or Both. The owner chooses; no default is offered.
fields.label: Consent evidence

fields.description: How many days a recorded consent remains valid before it expires. Owner policy; engineering invents none.
fields.label: Consent expiry days

fields.description: Plain-language summary of the records/recording rights under this version (what guardians may see and record). Bounded owner policy text; engineering invents none of it.
fields.label: Records and recording rights

fields.description: Why this version was set. Mandatory on every version write.
fields.label: Reason

fields.description: Closed date: the day this version stopped governing new activity. Written once when a newer version supersedes it; the row itself is never rewritten.
fields.label: Superseded on
